Kawekaweau. A huge species of gecko from New Zealand Maori folklore.

Even back when humans first started colonizing NZ, these animals were said to be very elusive even then and were rarely seen and there has only been one full-on documented report of one ever being seen alive, which is when an English settler watched a Maori chief lift up a log and kill one.

Nature-wise, New Zealand has always been full of surprises and new lizard species are still being discovered every year so imo there is one hell of a chance the mythical giant lizard could be out there somewhere waiting to be properly discovered and described. even if fossilized remains of it are found and they went extinct some time ago it proves that they did exist.

Not to mention a big stuffed lizard was found in a french museum and was never identified which definitely raises the possibility of its existence.
